name: Ball of Yarn
effect: Once per run, extract the whole party from any room, not just after a boss, keeping loot as if you'd beaten the last boss you passed.

name: The Whole Shelf
effect: While in the Basalts, you have every spell on your class list prepared.

name: Master Weaver
effect: Once per room, when an ally within 60 ft drops to 0 HP, use your reaction to cast a healing spell on them without spending a slot.

name: Chain of Echoes
effect: Keeps Level 3. If echoes hit the same enemy 4 times in one turn, you rise 10 ft and slam down, causing a 30 ft echo for 50% damage. The slam adds an echo to the next echo that hits an enemy other than the big echo's main target.

name: Nothing Personal
effect: Hitting an enemy from behind lets you teleport behind another enemy for a free attack at 50% damage. On a hit it repeats, up to PB times, until you miss or kill. A kill during the chain earns the Reaper's favor: his scythe lands on the first attack of your next hit for significant damage.

name: And You Get a Spell!
effect: When a single-target spell hits, cast it for free at another target. If that hits, you also get your three-target cantrip cast. Spells of 6th level or higher can be copied only once per room.

name: Samurai's Wake
effect: You get the Level 3 teleport, and enemies in the line from you to the target take lightning damage. You then turn and teleport back to your starting position, hitting the target again.

name: Elemain's Retribution
effect: Ricochets 3 + PB times. Crits split into two projectiles, and splits don't ricochet. Ricochets can return to the same target, dealing 25% less damage for each repeated hit, compounding (50%, then about 38%, 28%, 21% and so on). Built for groups, but still useful against a single target.

name: Battlefield Artist
effect: Keeps Level 3. Puddles now form whether a creature fails or succeeds on its save. Puddles of different elements combine when they touch: fire and cold make steam that heavily obscures the area, and lightning arcs between any puddles it touches.

name: Overflowing Cup
effect: Temp HP from Overhealing stacks with other temp HP instead of replacing it.

name: Titan's Hide
effect: Once per room, as a bonus action, gain resistance to all damage until the start of your next turn, and enemies within 10 ft can only attack you.

name: Hex Unwoven
effect: Your heals also end curses and remove one level of Exhaustion, and the pulse reaches 20 ft.

name: Mirror Step
effect: You no longer need to Dodge: when an attack misses you, teleport up to 10 ft and counterattack for +PB damage.

name: Pull From the Weave
effect: Your spell slots no longer have levels: any slot can cast any spell you know, at any level up to your highest slot. Wish and other reality-altering spells still need a slot of their own level.

name: Arc Conduit
effect: The extra damage chains to every creature within 10 ft of the first target.

name: Twin Focus
effect: Once per room, concentrate on two spells at once until the end of your next turn.

name: Every Moving Thing
effect: Once per round while you haven't moved, make a ranged opportunity attack against any creature that moves within your range.

name: Rain of Splinters
effect: The area grows to 20 ft, and you choose which creatures in it are hit.

name: Gone in the Gaps
effect: While hidden, you can move through creatures' spaces, and your first hit each turn deals +2 × PB damage.

name: Opening Contract
effect: Your first hit in each room also deals maximum damage on its dice.

name: Stride Step
effect: Bring one willing ally within 5 ft with you; both of you are Invisible until the start of your next turn.

name: Shared Flame
effect: Once per room, a single-target buff spell of any level can target one extra ally.

name: Lodge Backing
effect: The die becomes a d10, and you can grant it as a reaction after the ally sees their roll.

name: Hunting Party
effect: Every ally who hits the enemy this round deals +PB damage, not just the first.

name: The Hoard
effect: Once per floor, keep one extra summon from a spell for a whole room without concentrating on it.

name: Life Weaver
effect: You can weave one ally into the link as well.

name: Express Line
effect: Your hit bonus carries into your next turn as long as you hit at least once each turn.

name: Champion of the Ring
effect: While Bloodied, you make one extra attack when you take the Attack action.

name: Thils's Maze
effect: Once per room, set your own trick: a 10 ft square where entering enemies must make a Dex save against your DC or take 4 × PB damage and be Restrained.

name: God-Slayer
effect: Eyes build against any creature, and at 9 Eyes your hit ignores resistance and immunity.

name: Token of Whim
effect: Once per floor, flip the token. Heads: a dying ally returns at half HP. Tails: a non-boss enemy below PB × 10 HP drops to 0.

name: The Rift Below
effect: Creatures affected by your control spells take 2 × PB psychic damage at the start of each of their turns.

name: Living Labyrinth
effect: Pulled creatures are also Restrained until the end of their next turn.

name: Seismic Aftershock
effect: When your delayed echo triggers, it erupts in a 10 ft radius around the target, dealing its 40% damage to every enemy there and knocking them prone.

name: Phantom Phalanx
effect: Every 20 ft you move leaves a solid afterimage in the space you left (up to PB). Once per turn, when you attack, each afterimage makes an echo strike against an enemy within 5 ft of it for 50% damage.

name: Bell Tolls
effect: Your execution threshold (5 × PB HP) triggers whenever an enemy starts its turn within 15 ft of you, dropping it to 0 HP with no attack roll. Bosses below 10 × PB HP take 3 × PB necrotic damage at the start of their turns instead.

name: Soul Furnace
effect: Your Soul cap doubles, and you can spend 3 Souls at once, with no action, to take an extra turn after this one (once per floor) or turn a hit into a critical hit.

name: Apex Predator
effect: Mark up to 3 creatures at once. Your attacks against any marked creature also deal your 2d6 mark damage to every other marked creature within 30 ft.

name: Fatal Anatomy
effect: Once per room, declare an enemy vulnerable to your next attack's damage type until the end of your turn. Immunity becomes resistance, and resistance becomes normal damage.

name: Death by a Thousand
effect: Once per room, when a creature fails its save against your 4-hit Stun, immediately make PB free attacks against it.

name: Twin Tempest
effect: Your bonus action attack becomes two attacks, and both get Second Hand's damage and prone riders.

name: Crimson Sovereign
effect: Spending your own HP can't drop you below 1. Whenever you spend HP for Bleed Out, every enemy within 15 ft takes necrotic damage equal to the HP you lost.

name: Undying Rage
effect: When your Level 3 effect triggers at 0 HP, dropping an enemy before the end of your next turn ends the fall, restores you to 3 × PB HP and refreshes the Level 3 use for the room.

name: House Always Wins
effect: When you roll a natural 1 on any d20 Test, or an enemy rolls a natural 20 against you, it becomes a critical success for you and a normal miss for the enemy.

name: Tectonic Anchor
effect: While rooted, the ground within your reach is difficult terrain for enemies, and as a bonus action you can stomp to pull every creature within 20 ft into your reach.

name: Alpha's Call
effect: When you take the Attack action, your summon or companion makes one free attack against your target without using its action or reaction.

name: Entanglement Rift
effect: You can also swap places with an unwilling enemy within 30 ft of your companion if it fails a Cha save against your DC, and you and your companion each get a free reaction attack against it.

name: Prismatic Barrage
effect: Your ranged hits apply fire, cold and lightning at once for +3 × PB total damage, and hitting a target already carrying all three triggers a 10 ft elemental explosion for 2 × PB damage.

name: Immortal Banner
effect: Wear the standard on your back so the aura moves with you and can't be knocked over. Once per room, allies in the aura who drop to 0 HP drop to 1 instead.
